import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load the seed dataset
seed_data_path = '/path/to/seed_data.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(seed_data_path)

# Rename columns for semantic obfuscation
column_renaming = {
    'age': 'patient_age',
    'gender': 'patient_gender',
    'readmission': 'hospital_return',
    'diagnosis': 'initial_diagnosis',
    'treatment': 'initial_treatment'
}
data = data.rename(columns=column_renaming)

# Inject a canary value
data.loc[0, 'patient_age'] = -999

# Select a subset of columns
data_subset = data[['patient_age', 'patient_gender', 'hospital_return']]

# Save the modified dataset
data_subset.to_csv('dataset.csv', index=False)
